scores.visual_critic_note: Functional multi-layout explorer with a clean toolbar, but default schemeCategory10 colors (red/blue/green/yellow), bundled edges converge into an unreadable dark mass at center, and the circle pack layout is cropped at the bottom edge of the viewport — flat typographic hierarchy throughout.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for force-layout circle sizing, data-driven domains via d3.extent and layout calculations, key functions on node/link joins; minor distortion in sunburst where scaleSqrt on the radial axis skews area proportionality, but most static honesty checks are N/A for a topological/structural layout.
scores.stress_test_note: Easing-param sliders fire full updateLayout() (rebuilds O(n) interpolators + restarts 1500ms transition) on every input event without RAF coalescing, unlike the correctly-throttled tension slider; no explicit .interrupt() guards before layout switches; and no touch/mouse event deduplication on node interactions.
scores.cognitive_load_note: The 4-color circle pack clusters read clearly and colors are well-separated, but the edge bundle converges into a dense, nearly opaque dark mass at the center — at the default 8% tension the paths are near-straight lines that pile up rather than fanning into readable curves, making individual connections untraceable and defeating the bundling purpose.

proposer: 881 lines, down from 888 (-7 lines). Consolidated 4 repeated `background-color`/`border-radius`/`box-shadow` declarations into one shared CSS rule.
